description: This file defines classes, types, and functions related to instrumentation and SDK object management within the Playwright core server. It includes event handling, object attribution, and instrumentation hooks for browser, page, dialog, and download events.

classes.name: SdkObject
classes.description: Represents an SDK object with attribution and instrumentation, capable of emitting events and managing its lifecycle.

methods.name: closeReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for closing, checking page, context, and browser attribution.

methods.name: createRootSdkObject
methods.description: Creates a root SDK object with a fake parent, used as a starting point in the SDK object hierarchy.

methods.name: createInstrumentation
methods.description: Creates an instrumentation object with proxy-based event handling for various SDK events.
